title: Conflict Rows Highlighted
description: The banner at the top of the board isn't the only place a scheduling conflict should be visible — FR-902's calendar/schedule view is supposed to mark the specific conflicting rows in context too, so a dispatcher scanning the table doesn't have to cross-reference a separate warning.
successCondition: After creating two overlapping assignments for the same driver (or vehicle), both conflicting rows in the Schedule table render with a distinct highlighted background (bg-negative-50, distinguishable from the default row styling) and the Driver cell of each conflicting row includes a warning icon element with aria-label="Scheduling conflict" — while any non-conflicting row in the same table shows neither.
hints: The highlight logic checks each assignment's id against the flattened assignmentIds from GET /api/fleet/conflicts — conflicts are computed server-side, not guessed client-side from overlapping times you see in the UI.
Create a third, non-overlapping assignment alongside the two conflicting ones so you have a clean row to confirm does NOT get the highlight, ruling out a bug that marks everything.
